title: POLL: Having The Dreams? VS Online-Social Game? VS Trolling?
content: I pre-empt this with the sincere statement of not meaning anything aggressive BUT... If you HAD to guess, what % of people here (in r/TheMallWorld) are actually "having the dreams" & what % are playing a social/online game about it? Worse what percent may be trolling for kicks? It's sad but let's face it, Subjectivism sucks and has such inevitable drawbacks built in. Anyway, **Love to hear your percentage guess** & then thoughts about it.
